messages:
Maya: Heads up — Veridian reached out. They want to roll Redwood into two additional product teams (search + recommendations) and start embedding-based similarity for user profiles. They say latency has to stay <120ms for 95th percentile and they're already seeing token spikes during batch reindexing. Can we triage capacity and enablement?

Jorge: Nice signal. Renewal is in 9 months — this could expand ARR if we move fast. Do we know their current committed capacity or is it pay-as-you-go?

Maya: Currently PAYG. Last month average tokens/day ~120M, but embeddings job last week spiked to ~520M over 6 hours (burst). They asked about Dedicated pricing and whether we can guarantee throughput for night reindexes.

Priya: We should offer a short enablement workshop for the two new teams. 1-hour tech onboarding + a 2-week pilot with focused eval prompts. Can prepare a playbook for embedding quality checks and batching knobs.

Ben: From infra side, need more detail on concurrency and sequence length. Embeddings are less seq-length sensitive but QPS matters. If bursts are 500M tokens in 6h that's ~23k tokens/sec sustained during spike — need to map to GPU throughput. Any logs?

Maya: Pasted the compressed job metrics from their side: ```peak_qps: 6500
avg_seq_len: 1.2
avg_tokens_per_embedding: 1
spike_window_secs: 21600
burst_tokens_total: 520000000``` They run nightly reindex at 02:00 UTC.

Sam: tagging infra team. @Ben can you sanity-check if Dedicated 2x pool covers that burst without throttling? Also we should propose an autoscale policy with burst credits.

Ben: Quick estimate — Dedicated 2x with concurrent workers + KV cache should handle it if we enable prefix caching and use efficient batching. But they may need a short warmup before the window. If they insist on hard SLO, recommend Dedicated + pre-warm + fallback to smaller model for non-critical steps.

Jorge: From AE side I can push a committed monthly for Dedicated if we include an enablement package. Maya — any signal on org-level champions?

Maya: Champion is Lina (search PM). She's willing to be our partner for the pilot. Lina asked also about logging retention for compliance; they may want 90d audit logs for embeddings requests.

Priya: We can include a 2-hour QBR + audit log config in the pilot scope. Also propose a small eval suite for embedding regressions — helps us monitor quality post-rollout.

Ben: Action: I'll create an infra runbook with pre-warm steps and a recommended autoscale policy (burst credits, fallback model mapping).

Sam: I'll open a capacity request and flag as high priority for the weekend reindex. Ticket: CS-4127 (provision-dedicated-request). Include expected spike window and lead time.

deploy-bot: Reminder: quota increase requests submitted after 17:00 UTC may take 48-72 hours to process.

Jorge: Let's lock a customer QBR next week to align stakeholders and agree on pilot milestones. Maya — can you set the invite and include Lina + infra/solutions?

Maya: Yep — sending calendar now. Action items summarized: 1) Ben -> infra runbook + autoscale policy, 2) Priya -> enablement playbook + eval suite, 3) Sam -> capacity ticket CS-4127 (provision), 4) Jorge -> commercial options + committed pricing for Dedicated, 5) Maya -> schedule QBR and collect audit/logging requirements from Lina.

Priya: Also note potential renewal risk if we don't provide clear throughput plan — call this an upsell-with-risk. Recommend we prioritize this for next-week sprints. :warning:

Maya: Agreed. I'll push this as P0 for CS until pilot scope is agreed. :thumbsup:

Ben: I'll drop preliminary runbook in the ticket by EOD tomorrow.

Sam: I'll update CS-4127 with estimated cost delta and timeline.

Jorge: Thanks team — big expansion signal. We'll treat this as high-priority.
